about: Gate registry of Explainer v3 Tier A (DESIGN_tierA.md section 1, frozen at R0, 2026-11-13). This file is the only valid numbering. v2 gates G1-G13 keep their DESIGN_final section 4 meaning. A unit may not add a gate id: a new check is proposed to R0/the integrator and enters as a new entry here, never as a private id. kind 'gate' blocks a stage; kind 'report' is measured and written down, never blocks.

gates.name: hero identity
gates.definition: Hero seek(p) FrameState JSON at 500 seeded p, layout.solve boxes over the G1 matrix, activeLines output, bound E2/E4 values on cells 125/263, story_vtt --check, picker-off DOM: all byte-identical to the 8557cac snapshot. 5 seeded defects must fail it. --update refuses without HERO_CHANGE_NOTE.

gates.name: layout (v2)
gates.definition: v2 DESIGN_final section 4 meaning, run per story. The G1 size table is measured per story (DESIGN_tierA section 6.4).

gates.name: type floor (v2)
gates.definition: v2 meaning, per story (no text below 12 px).

gates.name: beam vs text (v2)
gates.definition: v2 meaning, per story: the projected beam never crosses a placed text or equation box (every G1 viewport x zoom x 160 p).

gates.name: chrome in flight (v2)
gates.definition: v2 meaning, per story (at most 4 chrome elements in flight).

gates.name: contrast on frames (v2)
gates.definition: v2 meaning; GPU frames per story.

gates.name: darkness on frames (v2)
gates.definition: v2 meaning; GPU frames per story. At most 1 documented G11 exemption per story beyond the v2 B2/B6 ones.

gates.name: GPU frame time (v2)
gates.definition: v2 meaning, on the heaviest story.

gates.name: budget (v2 + per-story rule)
gates.definition: Page shell may grow <= 3 kB gz; each story's first-3D-frame bytes <= hero x 1.15; story files <= 1.5 MB; GPU <= 448/192 MB. The existing v2 shell failure is an owner item (DESIGN_tierA section 9), not a Tier A blocker.

gates.name: determinism and film PSNR (v2)
gates.definition: Determinism; film PSNR >= 45 dB on role chunks per story.

gates.name: accessibility (v2)
gates.definition: v2 meaning, per story, including picker states.

gates.name: captions (v2)
gates.definition: v2 meaning, per story; G10 via activeLines.

gates.name: role-based beat claims
gates.definition: Bound values equal worked.<role> recomputed from cells; the 'new dip' key = argmax delta-tau in each director window; a role with ok:false has its equation dropped and logged.

gates.name: subject visibility
gates.definition: Non-empty cases: at each cloud-beat midpoint the lettered cloud's projected box has >= 3 % of its pixels with luminance > 0.25. Empty case exempt by rule, but its halo must not be black: >= 2 % of frame pixels > 0.15 in B1/B2, nor saturated: <= 30 % of frame pixels > 0.15 (fix2).

gates.name: letters and speeds
gates.definition: Every shown letter is a CREST encounter on the ray; every lettered encounter has a beat window holding >= 50 % of its column; each lettered encounter's V matches the catalogue V within 10 km/s (checks galaxy.vsys).

gates.name: case and teaching claims
gates.definition: The declared case's case/1 rule passes and every claims[k].pass it needs (DESIGN_tierA section 3), on Trident totals, never SBI. Each copy line carrying a lesson declares claims:[...]; lint fails if a claim is false for that story.

gates.name: engine validity fuzz
gates.definition: plan -> compose -> direct (repair off) on all 1345 staged stories + 4 hero rays + all picks/alternates. Hard: 100 % on picks, alternates and hero rays (schema-valid, windows ordered and covering [-half, +half] with no holes, every @role resolves, no copy hole, byte-identical rerun). Pool: >= 99 %; failures bucketed by cause, not debugged ray by ray.

gates.name: repair coverage
gates.definition: G3/G19/G20 after repair on a stratified sample of 200 staged stories (40 per case label); report pass rate (target >= 95 %) and reasons. Report, not a ship gate.

gates.name: disk
gates.definition: Outside B0/B2 the disk ellipse (radius 2 x stellar half-mass radius, floor 10 kpc, from galaxy.disk) covers <= 15 % of the frame and never sits behind the dock, tethers or text column; the camera never enters the slab |z_disk| < 2 kpc within 30 kpc; in tableaux the view direction is >= 60 deg from the disk normal so an edge-on disk reads as a thin line.

gates.name: LOD floor
gates.definition: Frame width at the target >= 48 voxels of the finest cube level that contains the target, levels read from the hosted manifest_v2 at bake time (L0 +-400 kpc: >= 150 kpc; L1 +-100: >= 37.5 kpc; L2 +-25: >= 9.4 kpc for 256^3 grids).

gates.name: hero check
gates.definition: Director on the hero passes G1/G3/G12; letter windows overlap the hand windows by >= 60 %; timing calibration within +-25 %/beat and +-5 % total; TF percentiles within 0.3 dex. The generated hero never ships.

notes.G7: v2 notch/input gate; not re-listed in DESIGN_tierA section 1. Kept with its v2 meaning; the director scales G7 notches by target/312 (section 6.2 step 3).
notes.G13: v2 beat-claim gate on the hero; superseded for generated stories by G13r (role-based), unchanged for the hero.
